name: project-dev-orchestration
description: Issue-to-PR lifecycle skills and an orchestration engine for running a team of coding agents on any GitHub project.

interface.shortDescription: Issue-to-PR lifecycle skills for agent teams
interface.longDescription: Intake, design, build, PR review, review triage, QC and close-out skills that work on the git repo of the current directory, driven by the repo's .agents/project-profile.md. Pairs with the optional orchestration engine in bin/.
